methodology.circuits: Generated by benchmarks/performance/scaling-m2-fixture.mjs; one byte-identical deck per circuit/size, SHA-256 checked across every cell
methodology.statistic: median primary; min, p95, max and every raw sample retained
methodology.isolation: one fresh child process per engine/circuit/size/solver cell; ngspice additionally starts a fresh native CLI per sample
methodology.spiceTsTiming: totalMs = parseAsync() + simulate(circuit); parseMs = parseAsync(); analysisMs = compile + analysis inside simulate()
methodology.ngspiceTiming: totalMs = native CLI wall time; parseMs = "Netlist loading time"; analysisMs = "Total analysis time" (.options acct)
methodology.ngspiceSolver: selected by a per-run .spiceinit (option klu | option sparse) in the netlist directory; the "Using ... as Direct Linear Solver" banner is verified per sample
methodology.failures: a spice-ts error stops the cell and records the error and elapsed time; timeouts are per sample (ngspice) or per cell budget (spice-ts)
methodology.memory: peak RSS including runtime baseline; spice-ts from Node resourceUsage, ngspice from its acct program size
